pairs: Quod si hostia pacificorum fuerit ejus oblatio,
But if his oblation will be a sacrifice of peace offerings,
et de bobus voluerit offerre,
and he wishes to offer it from the oxen,
marem sive feminam,
whether male or female,
immaculata offeret coram Domino.
he shall offer what is immaculate, in the sight of the Lord.
Ponetque manum super caput victimæ suæ,
And he shall place his hand upon the head of his victim,
quæ immolabitur in introitu tabernaculi testimonii,
which shall be immolated at the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony.
fundentque filii Aaron sacerdotes sanguinem per altaris circuitum.
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour the blood all around the altar.
Et offerent de hostia pacificorum in oblationem Domino,
And they shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings,
adipem qui operit vitalia,
as an oblation to the Lord:
et quidquid pinguedinis est intrinsecus:
the fat which covers the vital organs, and whatever fat is interior,
duos renes cum adipe quo teguntur ilia,
the two kidneys with the fat that covers the sides,
et reticulum jecoris cum renunculis.
and the mesh of the liver with the two little kidneys.
Adolebuntque ea super altare in holocaustum,
And they shall burn them upon the altar as a holocaust,
lignis igne supposito,
placing fire under the wood,
in oblationem suavissimi odoris Domino.
as an oblation of a most sweet odor to the Lord.
Si vero de ovibus fuerit ejus oblatio et pacificorum hostia,
Yet truly,
sive masculum obtulerit,
if his oblation and the sacrifice of peace offerings will be from the sheep,
sive feminam,
whether he will offer a male or a female,
immaculata erunt.
they shall be immaculate.
Si agnum obtulerit coram Domino,
If he will offer a lamb in the sight of the Lord,
ponet manum suam super caput victimæ suæ:
he shall place his hand upon the head of the victim.
quæ immolabitur in vestibulo tabernaculi testimonii:
And it shall be immolated at the vestibule of the tabernacle of the testimony.
fundentque filii Aaron sanguinem ejus per circuitum altaris.
And the sons of Aaron shall pour its blood all around the altar.
Et offerent de pacificorum hostia sacrificium Domino:
And they shall offer from the victim of peace offerings, as a sacrifice to the Lord:
adipem et caudam totam
the fat, and the entire rump
cum renibus,
with the kidneys,
et pinguedinem quæ operit ventrem
and the fat that covers the abdomen,
atque universa vitalia,
and all the vital organs,
et utrumque renunculum cum adipe qui est juxta ilia,
and both the little kidneys with the fat that is near the sides,
reticulumque jecoris cum renunculis.
and the mesh of the liver with the little kidneys.
Et adolebit ea sacerdos super altare in pabulum ignis
And the priest shall burn them upon the altar,
et oblationis Domini.
as fuel for the fire and as an oblation of the Lord.
Si capra fuerit ejus oblatio,
If his oblation will be a goat,
et obtulerit eam Domino,
and he will offer it to the Lord,
ponet manum suam super caput ejus:
he shall place his hand upon its head,
immolabitque eam in introitu tabernaculi testimonii,
and he shall immolate it at the entrance of the tabernacle of the testimony.
et fundent filii Aaron sanguinem ejus per altaris circuitum.
And the sons of Aaron shall pour its blood all around the altar.
Tollentque ex ea in pastum ignis dominici,
And they shall take from it, to feed the Lord’s fire:
adipem qui operit ventrem,
the fat which covers the abdomen,
et qui tegit universa vitalia:
and that which covers all the vital organs,
duos renunculos cum reticulo, quod est super eos juxta ilia,
the two little kidneys with the mesh that is over them near the sides,
et arvinam jecoris cum renunculis:
and the fat of the liver with the little kidneys.
adolebitque ea super altare sacerdos in alimoniam ignis,
And the priest shall burn them upon the altar,
et suavissimi odoris.
as nourishment for the fire
Omnis adeps,
and as a most sweet odor.
Domini erit
All the fat shall be for the Lord;
jure perpetuo in generationibus,
by a perpetual law,
et cunctis habitaculis vestris:
in your generations and in all of your habitations,
nec sanguinem nec adipem omnino comedetis.
neither blood nor fat shall you eat at all.
